# Ark Handyman

> Licensed and insured residential handyman services in Hamilton County, Tennessee. Serving Ooltewah, Collegedale, Chattanooga, East Brainerd, Hixson, Signal Mountain, and Soddy-Daisy. 9 years of experience. Free phone estimates.

Ark Handyman is a locally owned and operated handyman service based in Ooltewah, Tennessee. The business was founded after 8 years of experience in Colorado and now serves homeowners throughout Hamilton County, TN. All work is performed by a licensed and insured professional. Ark Handyman does not take on commercial projects — residential only. Free estimates are given over the phone upon description of the work needed.

## Services

- Drywall Repair: Patching nail holes, screw holes, cracks, and water-damaged sections. Texture matching (knockdown, orange peel, smooth). Small to large hole repair. Surface priming for paint-ready finish.
- Interior and Exterior Painting: Interior room painting, accent walls, ceiling painting, exterior siding and trim. Surface prep, priming, masking, and cleanup included.
- Tile Installation: Bathroom floor and wall tile, kitchen backsplash, shower surrounds. Waterproofing and substrate preparation. Ceramic, porcelain, stone, subway tile, and mosaic.
- Light Fixture Installation: Ceiling fans, pendant lights, chandeliers, bathroom vanity fixtures, recessed lights. Old fixture removal and disposal included.
- Sink and Toilet Installation: Toilet replacement, bathroom sink and vanity installation, kitchen sink replacement, faucet installation, supply line replacement. Old fixture disposal included.
- Flooring Installation: Luxury vinyl plank (LVP), laminate, hardwood, and engineered hardwood. Subfloor prep and leveling, transition strips, old flooring removal.
- General Home Repairs: Door and window repairs, caulking and weatherstripping, trim and molding repair, cabinet hardware and hinge repair, deck and fence repair. 1-hour minimum.

## Service Area

Primary service area: Hamilton County, Tennessee.

- Ooltewah, TN — home base, no travel fee
- Collegedale, TN — no travel fee
- East Brainerd, TN — no travel fee
- Hixson, TN — no travel fee
- Chattanooga, TN — may apply small travel surcharge
- Signal Mountain, TN — may apply small travel surcharge
- Soddy-Daisy, TN — may apply small travel surcharge

## Pricing

Starting at $150. Payment accepted: cash and check only. Payment due upon project completion.

## Business Hours

Monday through Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Saturday: By appointment
Sunday: Closed
